'''James Rouse''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[March 2001 Elizabethton tournament]] on 17 March 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB w/ B-wings]], according to Randy Koruschak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1908">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01d1908/ elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01], DeckTech (Randy "the tall guy" Koruschak, 17 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-17-elizabethton-tennessee-3-17-01d1908/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
